field.label: Enable
field.help: Run the ETPH client: the phone becomes the network interface etph0. Assign it under Interfaces: Assignments, give it a gateway (10.0.0.2) and use that gateway in a gateway group for WAN failover. ETPH Pro is needed on the phone for routers.

field.label: Phone address (Wi-Fi)
field.help: The IP address the ETPH app shows in Wi-Fi mode.

field.label: Pairing token (Wi-Fi)
field.help: The token the ETPH app shows; the link is cert-pinned TLS 1.3 keyed to it.
